identity.name: Arden
identity.notes: Arden is a gated, master-planned residential community in Loxahatchee, Florida (Palm Beach County), situated in the rural/suburban area near the Loxahatchee River and the Loxahatchee National Wildlife Refuge. It offers a clubhouse, resort-style pool, tennis, and trails, with a gated entry providing controlled access.

fees.note: Approximate range $250-$400/month; varies by lot and which sub-association applies. Covers clubhouse, pool, tennis, landscaping, and gate/security. Verify current dues with the HOA before purchase. CDD/special assessments not confirmed for this community.

Reported range ~$250-$373/month depending on source and home type; some listings show ~$978/quarter (billed quarterly). Exact current fee schedule not publicly confirmed; verify with HOA/manager (CCMC). Source is a secondary HOA-info site, not official HOA documentation. Range low end recorded here; high end $373/month per same source. Confidence low due to secondary source and conflicting reports (e.g., hoa-agent.com lists fees managed by CCMC but no figure seen).
Page states 'no CDD fees in many reports' for Arden; not independently verified against county/CDD records. Treat as unconfirmed.

amenities.detail: Walking/biking trails and landscaped green space

Resort-style pool flowing over two levels: peaceful upper pool with cabanas, lower play pool with swim lanes and adjacent hot tub; open year-round, dawn to dusk; children under 13 must be accompanied by adult; no private rental of pool/deck. Splash pad and fountains at lower pool (per ardenpalmbeach.com).

State-of-the-art fitness facility open daily 4 AM-10 PM; dedicated exercise rooms and large workout area with cardio and muscle-building equipment; large group fitness room with on-demand Wellbeats workouts; 14-15 year olds allowed with orientation and waiver.
9,900 sq ft community clubhouse: fitness center, cafe/tea & coffee bar ('the Hub'), high-speed WiFi, multiple event venues, outdoor patio overlooking the pool, floor-to-ceiling windows.
Dozens of miles of well-marked, mapped walking and biking trails encircling Arden Lake and looping through every neighborhood; virtually every homesite abuts a park, greenway or nature trail.
Tennis and pickleball courts (also basketball and playgrounds per myardenfl.com amenities page).
5-acre working farm (agrihood concept) with resident produce access.
24-hour manned gated entrance providing controlled access; community is gated across 1,200+ acres.
Pet limits typically up to 3 pets; also architectural review via Design Review Board, landscaping guidelines, no commercial vehicles, rental and noise standards.

CDD assessment status: 'no CDD fees in many reports' is unverified against Palm Beach County property appraiser or CDD records.

Nearest shopping center, grocery store, library, hospital, and school with distances were not verified on any page read; Arden sits off Southern Boulevard near 20-Mile Bend, so services are likely in Loxahatchee/Loxahatchee Groves or West Palm Beach, but no distances were observed.
